description: Exact number of distinct USDT transfer events on TRON before 1 January 2025 in the archive node's event table, against the number of stored rows. Rows are deduplicated on (transactionHash, logIndex); the table holds duplicate rows where blocks were ingested more than once. Counted with uniqExact over 64 buckets by cityHash64(transactionHash) % 64 (scripts/count_distinct_transfers.sh).
